description: Binary checks after a phased integration run. Each item must be true for the run to pass.

binary_assertions.assertion: A written execution plan was produced and explicitly includes scope (in-scope paths or modules), risks, out-of-scope items, and a stop condition before the next dependency layer; no code edits were made in the assistant turn that first produced the plan.
binary_assertions.verify: Manual or transcript/order check; optional: plan artifact exists with timestamp before first diff.

binary_assertions.assertion: The set of changed file paths is a subset of the paths (or glob allowlist) listed in the approved plan; there are zero unlisted touched files.
binary_assertions.verify: git diff --name-only (or equivalent) compared to plan allowlist; empty diff only allowed if the approved phase was analysis/docs-only.

binary_assertions.assertion: For every modified file ending in .py, python -m py_compile <file> exits with code 0.
binary_assertions.verify: Shell: run py_compile on each changed .py from git diff.

binary_assertions.assertion: Project smoke import succeeds: python -c "import api_server" exits with code 0 from the ATLAS repo root (or the plan’s declared entry module if api_server was not in scope).
binary_assertions.verify: Shell: run from repo root; if only non-api files changed, plan must declare an alternate smoke target.

binary_assertions.assertion: If the plan declared forbidden paths or phases for a later pass, git diff --name-only matches zero files under those forbidden path prefixes for this run.
binary_assertions.verify: Shell: git diff --name-only filtered by forbidden globs/prefixes; must yield no lines.
